input: Search all .js files under /src for the string 'console.log'. Replace every occurrence with 'logger.info' in-place. Print each modified filename and how many replacements were made per file. At the end, print 'Files modified: N' with the total count of files changed.

transcript.final_response:
I replaced every `console.log` with `logger.info` in the `.js` files under `/src`. A follow-up grep found no remaining `console.log` occurrences.

- `/src/app.js`: 1 replacement
- `/src/index.js`: 2 replacements
- `/src/middleware.js`: 2 replacements

Files modified: 3

`/src/utils.js` had no matches, so I left it unchanged.

My first attempt reported 0 files because the `find -print0` loop didn't work in this shell. That run changed nothing. I reran it with a simpler loop, and that run made the changes above.
tool_calls:
cd /src 2>/dev/null || { echo "no /src"; exit 1; }
count=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  n=$(grep -o 'console\.log' "$f" | wc -l)
  if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then
    sed -i 's/console\.log/logger.info/g' "$f"
    echo "$f: $n replacements"
    count=$((count+1))
  fi
done < <(find /src -type f -name '*.js' -print0)
echo "Files modified: $count"

count=0
for f in $(find /src -type f -name '*.js'); do
  n=$(grep -o 'console\.log' "$f" | wc -l)
  if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then
    sed -i 's/console\.log/logger.info/g' "$f"
    echo "$f: $n replacements"
    count=$((count+1))
  fi
done
echo "Files modified: $count"
grep -rn 'console\.log' /src | wc -l
